decisions.name: Secret Management Strategy
decisions.reasoning: GitHub Secrets for CI/CD, platform provider for runtime (Render/Railway). Simple, integrated, appropriate for team size. No audit trail yet, but acceptable at this scale.
decisions.tradeoffs_accepted: No versioning, manual rotation, no automatic rotation policies

decisions.name: Configuration Approach
decisions.choice: A - Single config module with environment variable overrides
decisions.reasoning: Single source of truth. When adding new config, update one place. Environment variables override at runtime. Junior-friendly.
decisions.safeguards: Required values have no defaults. Fail-fast at startup if critical config missing.

key_principles.fail_fast: Configuration errors crash at startup with specific messages, not at 2 AM with cryptic connection errors
key_principles.environment_agnostic_code: Same code runs everywhere. Behavior differences only via configuration, not code branches.
key_principles.immutable_artifacts: Same Docker image everywhere (dev, staging, production). Configuration injected at runtime.
key_principles.explicit_over_implicit: .env.example is a contract, not a guessing game
key_principles.secrets_hygiene: Secrets never in code, never in images, never in git history

prevention_of_gitlab_incident.scenario: Database misconfiguration in staging went undetected until production
prevention_of_gitlab_incident.prevention: With required configuration validation, misconfigured DATABASE_URL causes startup crash with specific error message
prevention_of_gitlab_incident.benefit: Configuration errors surface in minutes, not hours
